english.title: Send communication / article of an indecent / offensive nature
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) sent to **(..SPECIFY PERSON..)

(A)_[an article, namely **(..SPECIFY ARTICLE..),]_
(B)_[an electronic communication, namely **(..SPECIFY..),]_

which was, in whole or part, of an indecent or grossly offensive nature for the purpose of causing distress or anxiety to the recipient or to any other person to whom you intended that it or its contents or nature should be communicated
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1)(b) and (4) of the Malicious Communications Act 1988.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) The electronic communication may include text messages, fax and e-mail
(ii) Consider section 127 of the Communications Act 2003 - offences regarding improper use of public electronic communications network and services.
(iii) See also offence wordings: H12179; H12180 and H12181 in relation to sending messages.
(iv) Please see CPS guidelines on Prosecuting Cases Involving Communications Sent via Social Media as an approval from the Director’s Legal Advisor may be applicable.

Summary: Twelve months imprisonment and / or a fine
